name: Pawbook
summary: A money and people back office for vet clinics, with a cash chart you filter by clinic
about: A friendly back office for a business with a few locations, shown with four veterinary clinics. Owners and practice managers see takings and costs stacked by clinic, approve and pay supplier bills, run the weekly rota with leave requests, and keep licences and certificates from expiring.
how: Tap a clinic chip, or a pin on the little city map, to hide or show that clinic: the stacked cash chart reflows smoothly.
Switch between Takings and Costs and between 30D, 12W and 12M; the dashed line shows the other side so you can see profit.
On Bills, approve a supplier bill or pay it now and watch it slide away, with Undo in the toast.
On Rota & leave, tap any shift to move someone to another clinic or give a day off; approving leave fills in the rota.
Hover the expiry timeline on Documents and renew a licence before it runs out.
Compare clinics against their monthly targets on gauges, and change targets in Settings.
